correctness.rationale: Exact positive-arc cap double integral and Frenet Taylor expansion give A(s,h)=\(\kappa h^3/12+(\kappa_{ss}/480-\kappa^3/240)h^5+O(h^7)\). The series inversion and exact midpoint Jacobian yield the stated CDF with O(\(t^{5/3}\)); integration by parts produces \(J=\int\kappa_s^2/\kappa^3\). Jensen proves the circle extremum; the closed Fourier curvature-radius family gives exact \(J=2\pi m^2((1-\varepsilon^2)^{-1/2}-1)\) and its unique threshold. Conditional signed gap is exactly uniform, hence Scheffe gives joint TV limit and the curvature inverse by total turning. High-precision independent Green-theorem computations on ovals and exact circle inversion passed SMOOTH_CAP_AREA_CHECKS_OK. No numerical step is used to prove the asymptotic.

value.rationale: The smaller area removed by a random boundary chord is a natural local fragmentation invariant. Its leading small-cap probability is sharply circle-minimized, while the first correction measures a genuinely different nonnegative curvature-gradient energy, changes sign in a natural closed-oval family and is unbounded below. Rare-cut midpoint marks reconstruct arclength-labelled curvature, linking stochastic sampling to inverse rigidity; the exact threshold and inverse structure exceed a routine circle calculation or renaming of the short-chord distance law.
